messages.en: Simulation 3700B commencing!
For this simulation, many strategies will be needed, among them the following: Bertha bombardment, guppy transportation, terraforming, and extensive air combat.
Any luck cracking the format on that Message Artifact from Tiplex?
Yes, it appears to be a text from one of the civilizations that followed the Seloi.
As you recall, the Seloi were the only civilization to ever contact the Loki and get a response.
The message is a transcript between two researchers who devoted their careers to studying the Seloi.
The researchers believed the Seloi made a discovery regarding the intent of the Loki.  Unfortunately, the message contains no further details or descriptions.
I see, perhaps it was just some random data storage device that survived the Creeper.  It seems as random as our purpose is now....
Lia, did Platius give you no instructions... no hint of my purpose?  Did he save me just so I could witness the destruction of all things?  Was this some form of cruel and unthinkable punishment?
Everyone I ever loved has been gone for billions of years.  Even their memories have been erased and crushed by the Creeper....
Not entirely, Skars.  You are here and you still remember them.

True.... 
Ha...  the trouble Dax and Varro got into.  With Aliana always trying to talk some sense into Dax.  Those were good times, Lia.  I wish you could have met them all.
[Scanning System...]
I suppose that is prudent.  Let me know what your scans show....
Skars, this system contains five worlds, four of which are shielded.  The shield keys for these worlds appear to all be in this system, so that is some bit of good news.
What's the bad news...
Some of these worlds are likely to be very hazardous.  Energy signatures indicate the potential for more than just simple emitters...
Well, with great challenge comes the potential for great reward.  Perhaps these worlds will also hold clues as to our purpose.
Organics?  This world looks forested?
Chlorophyll is present, but those aren't simple plants on this world.  Everything here is a synthetic life form.
More Ticon technology?
Yes, after the Ticon developed the Digitalis there were unforeseen consequences.  The Digitalis incorporated patterns and techniques it picked up from organic life forms it found.
So, what look like plants and green fields are actually mutated versions of the Digitalis?
In a manner of speaking, yes.  If that were the end of the story, all would be well... but....
Let me guess, the Digitalis continued to evolve.

Yes, eventually mobile and discrete entities arose long after the Ticon were gone.  Subsequent generations would spend thousands of years eradicating these 'Runners'.  But they would always return after each civilization was culled.
Scanners show a square structure in that extinct volcano.  The Digitalis growth area seems to center around that structure.
That's a Runner nest.  Once the Digitalis connects to the nest, Runners will emerge that walk around on the Digitalis like primitive animals.
So the Digitalis not only copied plants but animals as well....  I see, how can we deal with them?

Fortunately, the Runners are not overly aggressive and won't destroy your structures.  But, they have an energy stun weapon they use for self defense.  Any unit that gets in range of a Runner might be stunned.
There is a Tech Artifact here...

Not surprising to find this here.  The Sniper Tech is specifically designed to take out Runners at significant range.  Pick up this tech and use it to create a perimeter around your base and your units.  That should keep the Runners at bay.

The emitters on this world are very weak, but don't underestimate the Digitalis.  Use anything you have at your disposal to fight your way through.  Also, more tech level upgrades are available in the Forge.
Knuckle Cracker would like to thank all of the fans and supporters that made this game possible.
Without your patience and support, none of this would have been possible.  And frankly, I wouldn't have wanted to do it without you anyway.

Thanks as always to Magnus aka MadMag (AcesHigh) for his awesome graphical talents and visual ideas.  Thanks as well to Grauniad for his patience and help with the Knuckle Cracker forums and for his ideas and support.
If you want to learn more about the composer of the awesome background music tracks, check out Finn M-K at composerprofiles.com/profile-finn-m-k and soundcloud.com/finnmk

A special thanks in advance to all of the players of the game who create custom maps, make videos, tweet, facebook, google+, and all that stuff.  Your efforts make the community greater and stronger and are most appreciated.

Oh yeah... this mission!  Roam around my little dungeon and see what oddities you can find.  Use WASD or arrow keys to move, left mouse to fire (just hold it down).  Or you can click the right mouse button to turn on auto fire if your finger gets tired.

Take out emitters by getting near (a red range will appear around the Emitter), then pressing SPACE to drop a Personal Nullification Device.  It takes 5 seconds to arm, but you probably knew that already.
And what about me?  Don't I get to say anything?
Uh, yes...  Yes of course.  I was just saving the best for last!

Uh hmmmm...
...
...
I forgot what I was going to say.
Excellent... this world should suffice for demonstrating the core capabilities of the ship.
There's a Creeper Emitter here!
Yes, I'm afraid so.  Much has happened while you slept.  Dozens of human civilizations rose and fell, each trying ever more desperate measures as the Creeper would always return.
The last whispers of the final civilization haven't been heard in many thousands of years.  As far as my sensors can ascertain, only ruins remain.
(Why was I forced to sleep through this all... only to awaken to utter desolation?)
Strange... This world seems to contain some manner of pod.  Technological remnants are rare, so I would investigate.  Follow the ships automated assistance system, and acquire that pod...
I've completed the scans of the various artifacts and technologies we have collected so far.
Did you find anything in common?  Perhaps something has been added to each item.
Nothing...  They are as diverse as any two random objects and contain nothing in common.
Then we have learned nothing....
Not so fast. We know that the Creeper did not destroy these artifacts but it did destroy other artifacts of the same kind. This can only mean one thing.
Ahh... The only thing these artifacts actually have in common is they were not destroyed by the Creeper.  That means...

Yes, that means that the Creeper somehow recognized these specific artifacts and did not destroy them.  It didn't destroy them at any point in their existence, which spanned many millions of years in some cases.

So the Creeper has a memory... a memory that spans vast amounts of space and time.  It also must rarely act in a selective way.   This never occurred to me before.  I've only ever imagined the Creeper as a random destructive force.
I'm not yet sure what good this knowledge will do us, Lia.  But it seems significant that the Creeper is more than just a blunt and crude weapon used by the Loki.
Have you completed your review of the Treatise on Cyclical Eternity yet?

Not completely, but it looks like utter nonsense.  No other civilization posited such a concept as a "universal singleton", something of which only one could exist.  The name 'Arc Eternal', which the Seloi gave to this object, must have had nothing to do with their message to the Loki.
I see...  So what do we have in this system?

This system was last called "Frykt".  It now contains only three worlds, as the others have vanished.  Of the former worlds, one was deorbited into the sun, and three others were deconstructed into material for a failed Dyson sphere.
Only one world is not shielded, so we will head there first.
It would seem so...  Skars, if we manage to take out the Inhibitor on Vapen there will be a choice as to the next system in range.  I have no idea which path we should take...
We will cross that bridge when we get there Lia.  My daughter Aliana always accused me of leaping before looking, so I'll have no trouble choosing a destination.
[Gel maintenance in process]
Again?
Something's wrong - we're coming down right in the pa...
At last we have arrived at the Warp Inhibitor world in this system.
This world looks like it was engineered for a fight...
Indeed it was... There is Ticon military tech everywhere.  There are even three surviving Bertha Cannons.  It is surprising they have not been destroyed.

Bertha Cannons can fire massive projectiles anywhere on the map.  There is no better weapon for inflicting huge damage to the Creeper.  Their weakness is they require significant ammo and have a long fire cycle.
That sounds like something worth fighting for.  I'll make it a priority to secure them.
Lia, it seems that the Creeper ignores some things.  Artifacts, messages, tech, now these Bertha Cannons.  What do they have in common?
Nothing intrinsic, perhaps there is something that has been added to each item.  I'll conduct careful scans of every item we have collected.  It will take some time to complete, however.
Alright, I'll initiate ground actions and secure this world.  Looks like some Emitters and some Slip-Emitters.  Those Ticon Towers, perhaps they are inactive?
Parked over space... space that has been carefully carved into a pattern....  it seems unlikely, but perhaps...
Another Ticon weapon system corrupted by the Creeper?
It seems unlikely... but the Ticon developed Gliders that would move through space.  The idea was to hit the Creeper from where it was least likely to persist.

These Gliders had powerful antimatter powered beams.  When in range they would combine all of their antimatter with matter and focus the energy into a beam.  Unfortunately for the Glider, it would be destroyed in the process.

I have no records that the Ticon or any subsequent civilization ever got the system to work properly and reliably.  So, it is unlikely to find them here.  But this spatial pattern looks like one of the testing grounds.
If this was a military testing ground and the Creeper has corrupted the Glider Tech, will there be any way to defend against it?

Destruction of the Ticon Towers would prevent the creation of new Gliders.  Of course any unit that gets in range of a Glider will be destroyed.  The only weapon in our arsenal that might damage a Glider would be the Sniper.

The focused beam from the Sniper was designed to penetrate the Creeper infused shells of a Runner.  That might be enough to penetrate the shields around the Gliders.  But this is all theoretical... The Glider weapon system was never actually deployed.
Well Lia, I have a feeling we're about to find out otherwise...
It was a hard fight to collect this message, so tell me it isn't just some entertainment vid.
I never would have believed we would find this... but this is the second part of the message we found on Ruine.

The treatise on Cyclical Eternity from the Seloi?  I recall that the Seloi were the only civilization to contact the Loki and get a response.  They said something about an "Arc" and the Loki responded with, "More so than all others, YOU must perish".
Yes, the Seloi were special in this regard and in many others....
So the first part of the treatise on Cyclical Eternity proposed that it is possible to create a device... something unique and singular to each universe.
But as I said on Ruine, the Seloi were prone to fanciful theories which had little connection to reality.
If that is the case then why do you seem at all interested in the second part of the treatise?
Because the name the Seloi gave to this theoretical device was; "Arc Eternal".
I'll need more time to process all of the message... and hopefully understand it.  I suggest heading to the next system as soon as possible.

This used to be an ancient human port.
It is no longer in use.
You can see many holes and problems  with the foundation that have formed.
If it is no longer in use what are those ships doing there?
That's a strange formation around the emitter on this world.
Yes, emitters arrived in ever more insidious ways.  Dropping from orbit, appearing directly out of Rift Space, subspace slips...
But why... Lia, in all the eons that have passed have you learned nothing about the Loki's true purpose?  Why do they cover all worlds in Creeper?

Humans made three attempts to contact the Loki, only one was successful.  There was one age, one civilization that was different from all others that came before or after.   They called themselves simply the "Seloi".

The Seloi's greatness wasn't in their military might, their governance of a hundred thousand worlds, or the lasting peace they achieved.  Their greatness was in the 'serenity' of existence they achieved.

They referred to this with a word not in your vocabulary, but what they achieved was an understanding and appreciation of the very fabric of existence.  In many ways they discovered the 'meaning' of existence.
And the Seloi were the ones to contact the Loki?
Yes.  When the end came for them as it did all others, they sent a message to the Loki pleading not for their lives but for something else.  Something they referred to simply as the "Arc".
What was the "Arc" and what was the Loki's response?
What the Arc referenced is unknown.  Perhaps it was a late discovery of some technology by these humans, or perhaps it was a very closely guarded secret.  I have no other references to it.
And the Loki's response?
A single statement; "More so than all others, YOU must perish".
(Sigh)....
Skars, this world contains two extinct volcanoes.  Emitters have taken up residence in each one .  I suggest you pick up the Strafer Tech Artifact on this world.
I got it... The Strafers are aircraft and I can use them to suppress the volcanoes while I deal with the central emitter.
Exactly.  You will likely need to target two Strafers on each volcano.  Don't waste any time... those volcanoes won't wait.
Greetings commander, in this TEST we will be bringing back an aspect of your past....  No nullifires will be allowed in this map.  You will need to connect all totems to win.  Have fun!
It seems quiet here... a kind of backwater system, removed from the comings and goings of most empires.  That makes it dangerous...
Why so?
Because I don't know much about it.  Little off-the-map places like this can often harbor great surprises.
There is only one world?
Yes, and it is a world that was left undisturbed for most of its existence.  It appears to contain an Inhibitor, though.  Someone must have recently placed it there.
What lies beyond this system once we take out the Inhibitor?

Scanning... It looks like a stable wormhole, Skars!  Fascinating.  For all the unassumingness of this system, it is actually a gateway to another region of space.  One about which I know nothing.  That wormhole could lead to anywhere in the universe...
This world also contains a Shield Key.  Odd since this system contains no shielded worlds.

I'll engage and collect the key and take out the Inhibitor.  As interesting as another region of space sounds, I have a feeling it isn't part of our current journey.  But perhaps we can come back and explore it later...
Where did my nullifiers go?
They won't work here, so I temporary removed them from your control panel. Scanners say that the creeper also reacts different here. Experiment to find a way to push back the creeper.
Once all totems are powered you can start nullifying and I'll enable the nullifiers again.

Activate all spatial totems to destroy the enemy!
Click each totem or use the number keys to toggle each peg. Moving some pegs unlocks others.  Press "space" to reset the puzzle and zero the game time.
I have only one thing I can say about this: This is going to be very difficult.
The first spore will come in one minute. Digitalis will slowly enter your base. You might want to enable show digi growth area to see the progress.
Any unit near the core will slowly die and lose all ammo, in return, their max health will increase.
If you manage to kill the tower, 4 copies of the tower will spawn in the corners. So be prepared for a lot of spores. I'll remind you by that time.
For now, build out as fast as possible and get a beam online.
Hmmmm...

I present to you: Warzone! This is the first map I made in one of the earliest builds of the game (way back in alpha!). Here it is, in its most raw form, aside from some added totems, this is the orginal map, just pure Creeper World Chaos! Also check out "War Zone" which is the updated version of this map for maximum madness!
There must be something wrong here. That emitter is showing extreme activity.
It recieves energy from unactivated totems. Try to connect (and arm!) all totems before attacking that emitter.
What in Odin's name....
This used to be 'Flick', a world that supported a population of over 10 billion.  It was torn apart by a collision... a big one.  Something that the planetary shield couldn't stop.
Like all the worlds in this system, this world wasn't even born when you were last awake.  This entire system developed, lived, and died while you slept.
There appears to only be one emitter left on one of the larger asteroids, along with an intact Shield Key and a new Tech Artifact.
Look more carefully, Skars.  This emitter has deployed Subspace-Slip Emitters.  These aren't true emitters, but are channels in subspace that the Master Emitter uses to dispense Creeper.
This allows the emitter to deposit Creeper in different locations all at once.  The civilization that first encountered this adaptation were crushed in less than one standard earth year.
Can these Slip-Emitters be destroyed with Nullifiers?
In a word, "No".  There is nothing to destroy.  They are just rips in subspace that the Master Emitter uses to transport Creeper.  The only way to seal them is to destroy the Master Emitter.
The best you can do is to establish a foothold on surrounding asteroids, then deploy weapons and AntiCreeper to hold the Slip-Emitters at bay.
The Bomber Tech Artifact should prove useful.  These air/space craft can deliver AC remotely.
Yes... I'll saturate these asteroids with AC.  Then, we'll get out of here.  There is nothing left here but death and destruction.
We've arrived in the Andere system, as it was last called.  Sensors are off the charts, and need recalibrating...
What's the source of the interference?
It isn't interference, it's information.  There are billions of data streams across billions of channels all carrying vast amounts of data... it's too... it's too much...
Shut down the sensors Lia!  Do it now!
Lia!

... ... The data streams...  I have the sensors shut down now.  The amount of information being transmitted was incalculable, Skars.  It was blinding to my Gel circuits.  I've never encountered anything as complex and ordered and on such a scale.
Could you determine anything about the signals?  Their source, their content, their purpose?

The signals appear to be coming from everywhere, but focused on this system.  It is like someone encoded quadrillions of yottabytes of data into the background radiation of the universe.  It is near the quantum limit for information density.
What is in the message?  Did you ascertain anything?
It seems to be everything, Skars?  Just 'everything'.
I don't understand, everything of what?
Everything that has ever been.  It's exact state information... it's... think of it like a very precise plan for how to make everything that has ever existed.
Every leaf on every tree that has ever existed on every world, every grain of sand, every star, every molecule of every atmosphere that has bent the light of its star into a sunset...
Do this, enable visual spectrum sensors only for this System.  Let's look at the system with just our eyes...

OK, looks like two worlds, one shielded and one not.  My records indicate these worlds were last called Otrav and Farbor.  There was nothing particularly remarkable about either world over the last few billion years.
You said the sensor streams seemed focused on this system... any particular region in this system?
Yes, good question.  In the time I sampled the streams they appear to be.... That's interesting.
The focus appears to be changing slightly so that the signals are at their peak over Farbor.  The signal focus is somehow tracking the orbit of that world.
Then that's where we are headed Lia...  The Loki must be behind these signals and this world must be significant somehow.
I'll attempt to install some filters on the sensors so I can better sample the streams. That should allow us to perhaps learn some more about the intent of the signals.
I'll head to Otrav and pick up any shield keys there...
Those look like primitive ruins?
Yes, they were meant to look that way.  This was a camouflage world.  Some civilizations attempted to hide from the Creeper by removing all obvious traces of higher technology.
It obviously didn't work.... the Creeper must have either not cared, or seen through the charade.

Some cultures on some worlds went so far as to actually maintain a more primitive existence.  They lost all advanced knowledge and even contact with the rest of humanity.  This appears to be one of those worlds.
Those step pyramids, there are strange readings coming from them.
The last indigenous culture must have taken technological artifacts and built these pyramids around them.  Perhaps they worshipped them or revered them in some way.  Impossible to know for sure...
But what I can say for sure is that the artifacts in those pyramids still appear functional, and they are rather advanced.  Skars, connect the peak of each pyramid to your power grid...
What will happen?

Each pyramid contains a defensive device that you should be able to power.  I'm not sure exactly what each will do, but it looks like someone long ago placed these artifacts here.  Perhaps it was hoped they would defend the population.

Interesting... and perhaps they did protect the population for some time.  Perhaps some inhabitants even managed to escape, for a while anyway.  In any case, I'll power the pyramids and take out that Inhibitor.
You should really turn off ammo packets at the start, at least until you've built a few reactors.
Hey guys! This was the map created for a Demo of How to create a map! I hope you enjoy it!
Excellent... That pod from planet Tempus contained a shield key for this planet.  Obtaining it allowed us to lower the shield and access this planet.
Entire planets shielded?  This must have been some desperate attempt to defend against the Creeper.

One that sadly failed.  The human civilization that developed this shielding technology had high hopes.  They accomplished many great and magnificent feats.  But the end came for them just like all the others...
There is a large structure here.  This must be the Warp Inhibitor?
Yes, these inhibitors restrict warp travel to other systems.  We need to destroy this inhibitor so we can leave this system.  Destroying the Inhibitor will destroy all other enemies on the map.
Why would the Creeper, or Loki, build Warp Inhibitors?
They did not.  I recommend acting quickly and getting us out of here Skars.  No world is ever safe for long...

Skars... wake up.
SKARS!....

COMMANDER SKARSGARD ABRAXIS!
Uh.. where... wha?  Wait a minute, who are you?
I'll keep the ship lights very low.  You have slept for a very long time.  My name is Lia.
I don't know any 'Lia'.  The last thing I remember is Platius laughing and saying, 'Fortuna favet fatuis'.  Where am I, where is Platius, and who are you?
Slowly...  Platius created me shortly after he placed you in suspended animation.  I was your guardian for the eons that passed.  I have watched over and protected you for many cycles...
I am part of this ship we are on.  We have been in orbit around a stable singularity for many eons.... hiding from all that transpired.
Just how many eons?
It is difficult to measure because of the expansion of space, the rift space cataclysm, variations in various cosmological constants....
Quit stalling, just a round figure....
Over 5 billion earth standard years.

My Gods....
...
WHY?  ANSWER ME, WHY???
I'm sorry Skars....  All I know is that 'now' is when I was to awaken you.  I, and this ship, are now at your disposal.  My only instructions from this point forward are to follow your commands.
None of this makes any sense, or even seems possible.  But, I long ago abandoned the concept of 'impossible', so let's take a look.  Ship's sensors indicate we are no longer orbiting a singularity...

Correct, I warped the ship to a nearby star system to begin the reactivation process.  Unfortunately, there appears to be a warp inhibitor in this system so we are stuck here till you do something about it.
Warp? Inhibitor?
Move the ship to 'Tempus'... the world without a shield. Then launch ground activities.  I'll explain more once there...
The phrase "beau geste" is from the French, meaning "a gracious (or fine) gesture".
In French, the phrase includes the suggestion of a fine gesture with unwelcome or futile consequences.
In English, "geste" is a homophone with "jest," meaning "a joke" or "to joke." As a pun, a "beau geste" may therefore indicate a beautiful (or poignant) joke.
It's also a movie with a desert fortress under attack...

Thanks to Virgil for the scripts and images (that i shamelessly "borrowed" from the meso map).
The idols have quite high energy demand, make sure you can run them before you hook them up!
Barren... this world has seen better days.
Yes, a very long time ago Jojo was a world with great mountains and vast oceans.  Humans across the vastness of time would visit this world for the beauty it offered.
And now it's a gray rock in space, with wait... What are those strange Towers?
In the south there are three Spore Towers, along with three emitters.  Fortunately, there is a Beam Tech Artifact on the central island.
Aerial Spores....  Coincidence?  On the first world we encounter with Spores there is also a technology to defend against the Spores?
This is all so similar to the original exodus of Odin City.  I always believed Platius had placed the artifacts we found on our journey...
I have no record of Platius since I was constructed.  If he was present over the eons, he was very well hidden.
I see.  I'll collect that Beam Tech Artifact and construct several Beam units to defend our base.  That should protect the units while I take out the emitters and towers.
Welcome to the Creeper Simulation Machine Version 6.1, My name is CS Advanced.  Welcome to your training as a Challenger of the Creeper.
Hello Trainee! I am CAIN, Comand Node Artifical Intelligence. I trust that you can get yourself through the mission, so I wil be mostly silent and just take notes on your performance.
Mission Report: Many emitters are in this world but you get some high ground to start. Runners and an air tower block your path. Collect the tech artifacts for more assistance on your battle.
Prepare the simulation, I am engaing the creeper in battle!
Simulation Number 84497884 starting please stand by to engage.
I have almost completed the simulation. May I recieve my next instructions?
You did very well on this mission. The next one won't be so easy however, prepare yourself for a challenging battle.
I will CAIN. Thank you.
Simulation Number 84497884 is almost complete preparing to stop simulation machine.
What is this? A new enemy?
No. My records say that in this place humanity tried to kill a single emitter. They used their own cores to create anti-creeper and AC spores, slowly growing stronger and stronger.
Many years later the creeper returned and it took over their systems.
So I now have to fight something that the humanity made to kill the creeper? Then you might know what it does.
[searching...]

Our nullifiers are not strong enough to destroy it. The core creates a lot of child cores using the energy stored. Those cores will gather some energy on their runs and will return all energy back to the main core after completing their run.

Nullify cores to 'drain' some energy of the main core. Once it's energy falls below a point it will sacrifice its immunity against our nullifiers for a small burst of destruction and some extra energy.
Be prepared for a lot of spores and build a few mortars to keep the creeper density's low.
Is there a way to win this fight, or are you doomed to failure?
This doesn't look good.  There is some Ticon tech here, but the structure isn't something they built.  This is very unusual.

Lia, there seems to be a pattern in the worlds we are visiting.  We know that the Creeper all but destroys everything in its path.  Something to do with entropy, or so my daughter Aliana once told me.  But each world we visit has something of value.
[Scanning World...]
Lia?  Something of concern?
Yes.... we have a serious problem on this world.  The emitter here is using subspace-slips.  But, the exit points aren't stable.  I have not encountered this before.
Not encountered it before?  Billions of years of observation and something you have not seen?  This can only mean one thing.  Something is aware of our presence and adapting.
This is possible, we have been very visible for some time now.  If this is the case, then we will be hunted ever more aggressively on each world.  This will complicate our exploration...
Focus on the task at hand... there is a Tech Artifact here.  It looks like some Ticon tech.
Yes, seems to be shield tech.  This may be the only way to survive this world, Skars.  Shields will repulse Creeper, but require significant amounts of energy.
I have also managed to enable some more upgrades in the Ticon Forge we acquired at Lemal.  I recommend constructing a Forge, and upgrading infrastructure as the situation demands.
I'll land a Command Node in the center of the base and focus on defense and energy... lots of it.  Let's hope those shields are useful against these random slip emitters.
Protect these dunes against the creeper Skars. In 2 minutes a gaint wave of creeper will appear, so get your bertha's ready!
This world is covered with tech and none of it looks very friendly.
It is tech, that is for sure.  It doesn't appear to be directed toward any offensive or defensive purpose, though.
That is odd, since most civilizations were interested in defending themselves and the Creeper was interested in destroying them.
This world has been designed to concentrate Creeper on each hill top in sequence.  That old Ticon facility in the east is projecting dual attraction fields that rove over the terrain.
What purpose is there in concentrating Creeper like that?  It makes it harder to destroy, but this world doesn't appear configured for defense.
Could it have anything to do with the intense signals you have detected focused on this system?  Focus your scanners on a hill top...
[Scanning...]
This is interesting, and subtle.  It seems that the structure on each hill is designed as a transmitter.  When the Creeper pools over each transmitter, I assume that is when each will transmit.
And this is where the signal in this system is coming from?
Absolutely not.  Well, some tiny fraction of it perhaps.  The signals in this system must be coming from billions of other worlds just like this one... all transmitting at the same time.
It's the Loki... it must be.  Everything over the last 10 billion years, their campaign to destroy everything in the universe with the Creeper... it has all been building to this.

Skars, if all of the Creeper from across the universe is the source of the signals it means the Creeper doesn't just destroy things.  It also remembers things in exacting detail. It would only be bound by the uncertainty principle, unless...
We are going to destroy those transmitters, that field projector, and collect the shield key from this world.  We must reach the next world in this system and discover what the Loki are doing.
This is the Navox system.  The worlds here have varied histories.
It seems that Flick and Tiplex are both shielded but the other three worlds are not.
Correct.  You have a choice as to how to proceed.  Scanners show various artifacts scattered across the worlds.  So the order you visit the worlds will determine what technologies we acquire first.
Tiplex is where the Inhibitor is, but it appears to require multiple shield keys.  That world must have been more important than others...
Choose one of the three worlds and engage ground operations.  I'll explain what I know of each world in turn...
go north or go east, it's up to you, but connecting point to point will give you what you need to win. (scripts from meso, thanks again Virgil, i love these powered idols!)
tek tip! packet speed is probably a good idea!
Oh no...
I'm not even going to ask... just let me have it.
There is a corrupted Ticon space weapon here.  It was another experimental system that I thought the Ticon never actually deployed but obviously did.
We've faced their tech before, this can't be any worse.

You may be right.  The station appears to be malfunctioning and operating in a much diminished capacity.  Its targeting sensors are destroyed as well.  So whatever it fires, it will be firing randomly into space.
Is that Ticon space station also acting as a Warp Inhibitor?

Great... I love a challenge.
This world is barely being held together.  It's near the end for this world.... geological forces have torn it apart, and disturbances in this system have done the rest.
Yet there are artifacts here...
This world has been uninhabited for over a billion years, so the artifacts must have been dropped here more recently.
There is also another matter of concern here, Skars.  I show an Air Exclusion (AE) structure on that hill to the south west.
Ticon or Seloi technology?

This is Tiplex, a machine world.  It was engineered by the Ticon Empire as a defensive outpost.

Their conflict with the Creeper lasted centuries, longer than any other civilization.  But the costs were unthinkable.  And in the end, they failed like all the others.

The Ticons developed a weapon system they believed would destroy the Creeper once and for all.  It was an artificial, self-replicating structure that derived its sustenance from Emitters.  It was believed this would 'immunize' worlds from Emitters.
And did it work?

How did the Ticon people cope?

And it appears as if this Digitalis still exists...

With regret, it seems so.  Skars, the Digitalis is a brutish and simple enemy.  It spreads along predefined pathways.  But, those paths don't respect terrain elevation.  Digitalis is tough, very tough, and your weapons will have difficulty damaging it.

What is worse is that The Digitalis replicates rapidly and will fill in destroyed areas with great efficiency.  Your best strategy is to try to cut it off from its source.  Digitalis requires a connection to an emitter to thrive.  If you sever that connection, it will cease to grow and eventually wither.
Digitalis also conducts Creeper rapidly and with no loss. So beware of this as it can move Creeper over higher terrain.
